prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon runner preparing for race day - carbohydrate loading with 3000+ calorie intake and hydration strategy

solution_criteria: Total daily calories meet or exceed 3000 calories
Carbohydrates comprise at least 60% of total calories
Includes hydration strategy with specific fluid intake recommendations
Meal plan is compact and covers one full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration strategy

prompt_inputs.goal: pre-match energy and recovery for soccer performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with breakfast, lunch, pre-match snack, and post-match recovery meal
All meals are vegan and tree nut-free with no animal products or tree nuts
Includes adequate protein sources (legumes, seeds, soy products) and carbohydrates for soccer performance and recovery
Portions are compact and concise (1-2 sentences per meal maximum)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific dietary restriction scenario (vegan soccer player or athlete with food allergies) requiring creative nutrient substitutions while maintaining performance nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and power gains through proper nutrition and workout timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers a full 24-hour period with at least 4 distinct meals
Protein-heavy macros with minimum 2.2g protein per kg bodyweight (~187g total)
Includes pre-workout and post-workout meals timed appropriately around strength training session
All meals respect lactose-free restriction with no dairy products
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing protein-heavy meals with specific macro ratios and meal timing around workout sessions
